_comment: Recorded baseline of /api/admin/* routes with NO authentication middleware. Shrink this list as Agent 1 repairs each route; never grow it. check-auth-coverage.php fails on anything not listed here.
_warning: Every entry here is an endpoint reachable with no credentials.
_verified_by: Agent 5, Phase 1B, real PHPUnit 11.5.57 run against baseline b4917c5b. Anonymous GET of categorylist/couponlist/taxlist/shippinglist/variantlist with store_id returned HTTP 200 {"status":1,"message":"successfull"}. Anonymous POST to orders/notes/create returned 200 and took order_notes from 0 rows to 1 with note_type=to_customer -- a confirmed unauthenticated write.

legitimately_public./api/admin/adminlogin: login endpoint -- must be reachable unauthenticated
legitimately_public./api/admin/delivery-login: login endpoint -- must be reachable unauthenticated
legitimately_public./api/admin/base_url: returns the image base URL; public by design

_post_integration_action: This baseline was recorded against routes/api.php at b4917c5b. Agent 5 measured p1b/agent1-auth with this same script: it takes the count from 13 to 4, closing all 9 of categorylist, couponlist, orderlist, productlist, shippinglist, taxlist, variantlist, orders/notes/create and orders/notes/delete. AFTER Agent 1 is integrated, run `php tests/Support/ApiContract/bin/check-auth-coverage.php --update-baseline` and the list must shrink to those 4. Do not leave the stale 13 in place: a baseline wider than reality silently permits a regression back to it.

_remaining_after_agent1./api/admin/adminlogout: still has NO route middleware, but the baseline probe returned 401 Unauthenticated, so the controller rejects anonymous callers. Low severity; worth a route-level guard for consistency rather than relying on the handler.
